description: This file defines extension methods for configuring a silo to use FaultInjectionMemoryStorage in Orleans testing environment. It provides methods to add fault-injection-enabled memory storage to the silo builder with customizable options.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add fault-injection memory storage.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionMemoryStorage
methods.description: Configures a silo to use FaultInjectionGrainStorage with specified options and fault injection options.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionMemoryStorage
methods.description: Overload that allows configuring options via OptionsBuilder delegates, with default null values.
